title: The test of an Apple Health read begun before Delete all my data holds its window with a 50 ms sleep against a 300 ms fake delay, so it relies on timing and flaked once under load
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmapTests/LiveHealthTests.swift:449-465 testAReadBegunBeforeForgetKeepsNothing_AC2: store.delay 300 ms (:454), Task.sleep 50 ms (:456) before the forced refresh and forget. Failed once at a 5-minute load of 16 (XCTAssertEqual access: unknown is not equal to granted, :461), passed on the rerun. Fix: the fake signals when its read has begun and the test awaits that signal, not a sleep. Same shape as S17
